en: A colorized historic postcard view of an urban square with a central green area, trees, flowerbeds and a monument. Around the square stand multi‑story buildings with awnings and terraces; one of them is labeled as a restaurant. A tram or bus is visible on the right, and several small figures walk across the open paved space. The caption at the top identifies the scene as Keizer Karelplein with the buildings Germania and Vereeniging in Nijmegen.
